VERDICT goal: the node goal is that the one family domain decision is offered options not bounded by its sources and is measured against the agreed reader labels; imas_codex/standard_names/domain_decision.py:764 widened_candidate_domains offers every domain of every source band plus every band umbrella plus general, :956 defaults option_set to fallback_escalated, and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-domain-per-family/widened-options.json records all four sets over the agreed 101-item reference and the 113-item ruled reference, so the goal is met.
VERDICT done_when: the dispatched done_when asks for a higher drawn single-name share than stored, a family member share not lower than the source-bounded arm in the same run, calibration at least 0.597 and not lower than that arm, at most 24 multi-member families below the floor, a planted unrelated-source name placed under the widened set only, judgments and cost per decision recorded, and the all_debug gate log committed; the gate log at revision d91bede9a records 19 passed / EXIT=0 and 6 passed / EXIT=0, widened-options.json single_names reads 0.6557 against stored 0.5410 and calibration 0.6272 strict against 0.6036, undecided_summary reads 24, and the planted clause is met by the widened arm (sdpf-widened-options.html:103 reads yes for widened, no for both fallback shapes); the one clause unmet on the node's own measure is the family member share, 0.4864 against 0.4875.
VERDICT write_paths: the declared scope is domain_decision.py, families.py, three test files, the harness, widened-options.json, the fragment and the gate log; every path in the twelve node commits is one of them, imas_codex/standard_names/families.py and tests/standard_names/test_domain_decision.py carry no change although declared, and the declared name tests/standard_names/test_domain_family_decision.py does not exist (the touched file is test_family_domain_decision.py, which the manifest's scope_note records as a dispatch typo).
VERDICT manifest: read; status complete after a coordinator status repair whose manifest.md.asdelivered reads blocked, with the reason citing the lead ruling of 2026-11-12; twelve commits b154adafd..a680c9ac3, changed_paths naming the seven touched files, the gate log at d91bede9a and three negative-control mutations at EXIT=1; baseline_suite and after_suite are absent from the manifest, so no arm delta is recorded.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from base 2fbffc362 to head a680c9ac3; the substantive change is imas_codex/standard_names/domain_decision.py (+245/-35 across six commits: OPTION_SETS, domain_bands, band_domains, build_family_domain_question, widened_candidate_domains, _decide_widened, _decide_bounded, the decide_family_domain dispatcher, split_undecided_family and the decide_and_write_family wiring) beside two test files and four evidence artefacts, and the repair commit d91bede9a deletes the uncalled all_domains and the dead widened flag the previous review named.

FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/sn-domain-per-family/sdpf-widened-options.html:306 non-blocking: the plan's done_when requires the decision run over every live family in a disposable copy with the share of names under transport and under general recorded beside the present 698 of 1,975 and the general count, with the twenty largest moves listed by family, and the fragment states this pass was not run, so one delivered clause of the section's measure is absent; it belongs to the live-pass node rather than to this one, so it is recorded for a fold instead of holding a change whose code is complete.
